title: Settings
summary: The Settings page: every category, every option and its default, and how to search and reset.

s.x: page in the K menu holds every option the pack adds, in one place. Options are grouped into categories with a search box on top, and changes take effect straight away. Settings are saved on your own computer, in
in your game folder, so they belong to you, not the server.

Type in the search box at the top of the left side, and the page searches every category at once. It matches names, descriptions and keywords, so "ding" finds the mention sound.
can be dragged. Buttons, such as Edit HUD layout, run an action.
is a button above a category's list. It appears once you have changed something in that category, asks for a second click within 3 seconds, then resets the category.
Some options have sections, such as Look or Mentions in Chat, to keep long categories readable.
